claim: The Horthy sweep scored ideas against FixFlow's own weaknesses and levers, not against how to lay out instruction files.
Sweep weakness W1: CLAUDE.md is 390 lines, nearly twice the length at which adherence is known to fall, and a trim is gated behind the knowledge-store pilot.

The Horthy sweep covered 326 sources, 46 blind Sonnet readers, 1,987 idea cards deduplicated by code to 1,906, clustered into 838 claim families, each scored by two Opus reviewers with opposite lenses.
The 2026-11-09 addendum added 36 sources and 311 cards with no disposition changed.
Of 1,906 Horthy idea cards only 75 (4 %) carry a measured number.
Nothing in the Horthy sweep survived whole: every surviving adopt (24 families) and trial (53) is the refuter's narrowed version.
note: This is the first-pass count; after the 2026-11-09 addendum horthy-proved-general.md#line 15 gives adopt 24 and trial 54 (78 kept).
